verdict.line: You lose if you let him land free Q (Last Rites) heals and kite you with E (Mourning Mist); you win if you force extended trades and all-ins before he gets his wall up.

brief.thesis: Yorick has no dash, no hard CC, and his only ranged tool is E (Mourning Mist) on a 12-8s cooldown — once that's thrown, he is a stationary melee target with just a heal-on-hit Q. Sett's W (Haymaker) converts every point of damage Yorick lands into a bigger shield and counter-punch, so Yorick's own aggression feeds the exact tool that beats him. This matches the measured 52.3% win rate over 1144 games with both lane and solo-kill advantage on your side.

theirWindow.when: he lands E mark then empowers Q
theirWindow.what: The armor shred and slow from E let his Q (Last Rites) connect and heal him back. Don't stand in melee range while his E is up — back off a step until it's thrown or you'll eat the full combo.

yourWindow.what: Yorick has nothing to stop you walking him down. Pop Q (Knuckle Down) for the empowered autos and sit in his face — per OP.GG, trigger your W (Haymaker) right as he commits his Q to punch through the trade before his heal matters.

start.why: Highest measured pick (81.3% of games, 52.3% win over 1259) and the sustained damage pairs with Sett's Grit-building — every auto you land or take feeds your W shield faster.

boots.why: 63.5% pick, 52.4% win over 922 games — Yorick's whole kit is auto-attack and basic-attack-empowering (Q), so flat armor shuts down the exact damage he deals.

core.why: Most-played rush (29.3% of games on this path) — the slow-on-hit keeps Yorick from walking away once his E is spent.
Shreds the armor Yorick stacks from Conqueror/runes and sustains your all-in tempo through multiple trades.
Appears in all three top build paths — the extra max health scales your W (Haymaker) true damage and Grit shield in extended fights.

situational.when: he starts building armor or you need burst mitigation in skirmishes
the game goes long and he's leaning on split-push sieges with Maiden
you need more sustained DPS to outlast his Q heal in longer trades
you're ahead and want to shorten your Q/E/R cooldowns to chain all-ins faster

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards exactly the extended, repeated-trade pattern that beats Yorick — stacks climb while his only answer (Q heal) can't outpace sustained melee damage. Highest sample page (31.1% pick, 53.3% win).

summoners.why: 89.5% pick rate and the highest sample (52.8% win) — with a built-in solo-kill advantage, Ignite shuts down his Q sustain during all-in windows and converts lane pressure into kills.

playing.title: Punish his Q animation
playing.detail: Last Rites has no mobility tied to it — if you see him commit to the empowered auto, walk up and trade through it since he can't disengage.

playing.title: Count his E cooldown out loud
playing.detail: Mourning Mist is 12-8s depending on rank and his only ranged tool. Once it's thrown, close the gap immediately — he has nothing left to slow or poke you with.

playing.title: Save W for his Q commit
playing.detail: Per the matchup data, trigger Haymaker right as he goes for his empowered Q attack — the stored Grit shield absorbs the trade and the true-damage punch answers before his heal lands.

playing.title: Use E to catch him off his wall
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns if he's caught between you and something on the opposite side — bait him away from his own W (Dark Procession) wall before you commit it.

playing.title: Abuse levels 3-5 hard
playing.detail: Once Facebreaker is point-and-stun capable, chain it into Q's empowered autos for the first real all-in window of the lane.

playing.title: Don't duel into Maiden after level 6
playing.detail: Mourning Mist against the Maiden's target deals bonus damage and raises Walkers from kills — if you're forcing a fight, do it away from any dead minions or jungle camps he's parked near.

playing.title: Ult to isolate, not to finish
playing.detail: The Show Stopper's 400 range means you need to already be close — use it to drag him off his wall or away from a Maiden rather than as a execute.

brief.patchCaveat: Item paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the trade-pattern and cooldown-tracking advice is my own read of the ability kits, not sourced from OP.GG.

stats.opponentTip: Pressure Yorick during early game to gain lane control. Afterwards, try to use [W] when he uses (Q) to gain the upper hand in combat.
